scripts.build: bun run build:pypi && bun run build:conda
scripts.build:pypi: pixi run -e build python -m build --no-isolation --outdir dist/pypi && pixi run -e build twine check dist/pypi/*
scripts.test: cd ../.. && pixi run -e default pytest -c packages/qgis-sdk/pyproject.toml packages/qgis-sdk/tests .agents/skills/skill-creator/tests
scripts.coverage: cd ../.. && pixi run -e default pytest -c packages/qgis-sdk/pyproject.toml packages/qgis-sdk/tests --cov=packages/qgis-sdk/src/qgis_sdk --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=lcov:packages/qgis-sdk/coverage/lcov.info --cov-fail-under=90
